links.comparator_used: Original, unsimplified burns first aid webpages (top 50 English-language pages), compared before and after ChatGPT-3 rewriting
links.outcome: Readability of burns first aid patient education materials across five validated readability tools
links.effect: PEMs meeting target on all tools rose from 4% to 18%; median grade 6.9 (SD=1.1, not significantly below target, p=.31) to 6 (SD=0.9, significantly below target, p<.001); all readability scores improved significantly (p<.001)
links.tradeoff: Even after AI rewriting, only 18% of PEMs met the target on all tools. The abstract does not report accuracy or completeness of the rewritten content.
links.quote: Once rewritten using AI, paired t-test demonstrated that all readability scores improved significantly (p < .001).

design_hint: reading-level constraint via LLM rewriting of patient education materials
